assessment.resource_class: released third-party surface-hexcrawl content/toolkit; public preparation workflow partially visible
verified: All three product descriptions distinguish ready map/scenario sets from own-map materials
Digital release is publisher-reported and current storefront exists
Fifteen interior previews fully inspected, with exact public locators and hashes
One named publisher-attributed custom Mycos map and its visible surface artifact
advertised_not_file_verified: Five pre-generated map/scenario sets per planet
not_established: Exact 1e compatibility statement in primary checked sources
Full generation procedure and numeric terrain distribution
Independent comparison proving the custom geography differs from every sold map
Contributor GM role, session counts, current activity and user denominator
VTT/editable project/export formats and permission for integration
assessment.decision: Retain as a concrete alternative/custom-preparation evidence source; do not call it an implementable generation profile or use it to raise p_create. A generic description/relocation/link workflow is the candidate reuse path, not a separate Mothership engine.
assessment.why_no_proposal: No measured creation share, edition-matched denominator, unmet-need or switching-intent observation; 341 backers and 15 prepared sets do not estimate those quantities.
assessment.market_implication: Existence of custom surface preparation is better supported; the finished paper example also weakens an assumption that no usable alternative exists. Neither direction supplies a numerical weight.
assessment.method_experiment: Not a new metric: existing resource_catalog / gm_materials / crowdfunding / event evidence contracts applied qualitatively. No new weights or active method change.
